newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury to revise SLGS rules very soon.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury to revise SLGS rules very soon.

text.p: The Treasury will revise "very soon" its rules for the State and Local Government Series securities, or SLGS program, to prevent their use as a speculative tool, an official said on Wednesday.

"The use of SLGS, particularly SLG subscriptions, as a cost-free hedge for speculating in open-market Treasuries is not an appropriate use of the SLGS," Deputy Assistant Treasury Secretary Roger Anderson told reporters.
"We are probably going to revise the SLGS rules very soon to clarify that position," he added.

Treasury last October issued final regulations designed to make the SLGS program easier and less costly for state and local governments that want to refinance and invest proceeds from tax-exempt bonds.
Recently, munincipal market participants warned Treasury that a loophole in the revised program could lead to abuses.
